trunk_decision.reason: The only real shared bus in this source is the routed /29: gateway .57 plus .58/.59/.60-.62. The renderer's trunk draws one corridor from `from` to `to` and one spur from that corridor out to each branch, so a hub-shaped bus can only be written as `from: <one member>, to: gateway, branches: [the other members]`. The source states every member's direction as member -> gateway (`nic -> gw`, `s2 -> gw`, `spare -> gw`); a trunk would have made one member the corridor source and drawn the other two spurs pointing away from the gateway, reversing two stated edges. Per the round rule, plain edges carry it instead.
